note: Franklin County TX has no published zoning district layer. Its ArcGIS GIS Map FeatureServer (parcels, floodplains, utilities) has no zoning layer. The county's largest city, Mount Vernon, publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (zoning_nov2023.pdf) and its districts only in the amlegal code library; no queryable zoning service found in ArcGIS Online or search. Texas counties generally do not zone unincorporated land.
